title: Efficient Mass Matrix Estimation with Gaussian Cooling
summary: We introduce an algorithm for efficiently preconditioning log-concave and log-smooth distributions that scales logarithmically with the condition number of the underlying distribution. Based on Gaussian cooling, our multistage method approximately samples from a sequence of well-conditioned distributions to construct a preconditioner for each subsequent stage of the cooling schedule.
